# U32: Search, filter and sort the goals in any layout, save it as a view, come back to it, and share it as a link

- **Belongs to:** the core ([the journeys](../journeys.md)); it runs with every module on, and the core journeys run again with each module left out
- **Requirements:** `SAVED-VIEWS`
- **Budget:** at most 18 steps on each width
- **Ease test:** all ten points ([the ease test](../../core/journeys.md#the-ease-test))
- **Runs on:** a phone (390 × 844) and a desktop (1440 × 900), the same lines on each unless one says otherwise
- **Starts:** As Amara, at `/goals?scope=all` in the demo.
- **Source:** `evals/journeys.cjs`, the entry for U32

## Steps and checks

- Open a fresh browser as Amara (`amara`).
- Go to `/goals?scope=all` in the demo.
- **Check:** (`entry`) the “Find a goal” search field is in view without scrolling (above the phone’s tab bar).
- _Note:_ Search finds goals by any word: a title, an owner, a reason.
- **Step.** Type “December date” into the “Find a goal” search field.
- **Check:** “1 goal matches.” is shown (else: searching does not say how many goals match).
- **Check:** (`attention`) the “Kafka moved to the managed service” link is visible or the words “Kafka moved to the managed service” is there (else: a search on the owner’s reason did not find the goal).
- **Step.** Empty the “Find a goal” search field.
- _Note:_ Filters: what needs someone. Then sort, and the same goals in the Table.
- **Step.** Press the “Filter(s / and sort)” button.
- _Note:_ Needs attention, narrowed to a slipped date: the one Needs attention rule, then why.
- **Step.** Press the “Date slipped” field in the “Filter goals” dialog.
- _Note:_ Sort is in the sheet on every screen (a phone has no room for it in the bar).
- Choose “due” in the “Sort” field in the “Filter goals” dialog.
- **Check:** Checkpoint “filters”: the screen is scored for `one-action` and `a11y`.
- **Step.** Press the “Show the goals” button in the “Filter goals” dialog.
- _Note:_ 24 need attention and 1 more is being handled, listed below them (Lane, 9 Nov, backlog GP): 25. The line says it the Needs attention way (goals spec, rule 4), since the filter is a reason to need attention.
- **Check:** “24 need attention: …1 being handled is listed below” is shown (else: the slipped-date filter does not narrow the goals).
- **Step.** Choose the “Table” layout (the Layout menu on a computer; the View sheet on a phone).
- **Check:** The table row in the tbody in the gtable (`.gtable tbody tr`) shows.
- **Check:** (`progress`) met when `rows === 25 && (await p.getByRole('button', { name: /Remove the filter Needs attention because date slipped/ }).isVisible())`, where `const rows = await p.locator('.gtable tbody tr:not(.story-row)').count()`. Else it says: table shows {rows} goals with the filter.
- _Note:_ Save it: a name is needed; then it's a tab of its own. Saving and sharing are in Views, or the phone's View sheet (GL2).
- **Step.** Choose “Save this view…” in the Views menu (the View sheet on a phone).
- **Step.** Press the “Save view” button in the “Save this view” dialog.
- **Check:** (`errors`) an alert in the “Save this view” dialog showing “Give the view a name” is visible (else: saving without a name is not caught).
- **Step.** Type “Slipped dates” into the “Name” field in the “Save this view” dialog.
- **Step.** Press the “Save view” button in the “Save this view” dialog.
- **Check:** The “Slipped dates” tab shows.
- **Check:** (`finish`) met when `(await openShow(p)) === 'Slipped dates'`. Else it says: the saved view is not shown as the current one.
- **Check:** (`logged`) met when `(s.views ?? []).some((v) => v.name === 'Slipped dates' && v.params.includes('needs=slipped') && v.params.includes('view=table') && !v.deletedAt)`, where `const s = await h.snapshot()`. Else it says: the view was not saved with its filters and layout.
- _Note:_ Back later: plain Goals, then the view, from the Views menu, brings it all back (saved views wait in one menu rather than adding tabs that run off a phone's screen, L&T 2).
- Go to `/goals?scope=all&view=list` in the demo.
- **Step.** Open the saved view “Slipped dates” (the Views menu; the View sheet’s Saved views on a phone).
- **Check:** “24 need attention: …1 being handled” is shown (else: opening the saved view did not bring its filters back).
- _Note:_ A shared link opens the same goals for anyone.
- Open a fresh browser as Rhea (`rhea`).
- Open a fresh browser as Rhea (`rhea`).
- _Note:_ A link from before release 2 (needs=slipped, without attention=1) opens the same goals.
- Go to `/goals?scope=all&needs=slipped&sort=due` in the demo.
- **Check:** “24 need attention: …1 being handled” is shown (else: a shared link does not open the same goals).
- Close this browser.
- _Note:_ Delete it: the tab goes. Rename, pin and delete are in Views (the View sheet on a phone), not beside the filters.
- If on a phone:
  - Press the “Delete this view…” button.
- Otherwise:
  - Press the Views menu.
  - Press the “Delete this view…” button in the “Views” group.
- **Check:** The “Slipped dates” tab goes away.
- Close this browser.
